👋 Welcome to SKJ Flow

    
Where blocks become code.

    

      Build real apps & games by connecting blocks — no typing code. Drag blocks from ＋ Nodes, wire them together, and hit ▶ Run.
      

New here? Start from a ready-made example — a to-do app, a game, even a 3D shooter — and tinker with it.

Keyboard shortcuts 

    

      
Ctrl+ZUndo

      
Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+ZRedo

      
Ctrl+DDuplicate selected node

      
DeleteDelete selected node / wire

      
`Toggle favorites bar

      
EscClose bar / dialog

      
Tip: tap ☆ on a palette node to pin it · your work autosaves
